event.title: Infantino Remains Silent on Future Amid Re-election Confirmation
event.canonical_title: Infantino Remains Silent on Future Amid Re-election Confirmation
event.summary: FIFA President Gianni Infantino avoided questions about his future during his arrival at the U-20 Women's World Cup. Despite his silence, FIFA has confirmed that he will stand for re-election next year, stating that 'nothing has changed.'

timeline.title: FIFA President Infantino to Run for Re-Election in March
